integrity: The proof uses exact line equations, full pairwise incidence, Hermite and Smith normal forms, an explicit mod-2 saturation test, and standard published geometric/K3 cohomology. Source texts are credited; no independent scientific verification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The arithmetic lattice theorem applies only to the standard Fermat quartic over F5; it relies on established complex integral line generation and standard K3 cohomological specialization. Its zeta consequence is not independently presented as novel. Publication priority is not independently established.
title: Integral Frobenius-trace Picard lattice of the Fermat quartic over five elements
